node_sections_covered: Inlet line from Existing Process Unit / B-L to 100T-01

possible_causes.cause: No or reduced naphtha supply from the upstream existing process unit.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank inventory decreases while HPU transfer may continue; this can lead to low tank level, reduced suction head to 100P-01A/B, pump starvation, and reduced or interrupted HPU naphtha feed.

possible_causes.cause: Inlet shutdown valve fails closed, closes spuriously, or fails to open.
possible_causes.local_effect: Naphtha inlet flow to 100T-01 is reduced or stopped.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: 100T-01 inventory decreases; 100P-01A/B may later experience low suction availability; HPU feed may become unstable or stop.

possible_causes.cause: Manual inlet isolation valve left closed or partially closed after maintenance or operation.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Gradual loss of tank inventory, possible low level, reduced pump suction head, and reduced HPU feed continuity.

possible_causes.cause: Outlet shutdown valve UV-0102-OUT, pump suction isolation valve, or suction line is closed, partially closed, blocked, or restricted.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Transfer pumps may suffer inadequate suction, cavitation, starvation, or dry-running; HPU receives low or no naphtha flow.

possible_causes.cause: Pump not running, pump trip, pump mechanical failure, coupling failure, motor failure, or loss of pump performance.
possible_causes.local_effect: Reduced or no discharge flow from transfer pumps.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: HPU feed is reduced or interrupted; tank level may rise if inlet flow continues.

possible_causes.cause: Pump discharge isolation valve closed, discharge line blocked, downstream HPU backpressure high, or common discharge header restricted.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Low or no HPU feed; pumps may operate near shutoff/deadhead condition; discharge pressure may increase.

possible_causes.cause: Minimum-flow recycle path excessively open or hydraulic imbalance sends excessive flow back to 100T-01 instead of HPU.
possible_causes.local_effect: Part of pump discharge returns to the tank instead of going to HPU.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: HPU receives less than required naphtha flow even though pumps are running.

possible_causes.cause: Upstream process sends more naphtha than expected to 100T-01.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank level rises faster than normal; potential high level, overfill, vapor displacement, and increased venting demand.

possible_causes.cause: Inlet shutdown valve or manual valve remains open when reduced or stopped inlet flow is required.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: High tank level or overfill if pump-out does not match inlet flow.

possible_causes.cause: Both transfer pumps operate when only one pump is required, or pump capacity exceeds the HPU demand.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: HPU may receive excessive naphtha feed; downstream process upset or high flow in HPU feed line may occur.

possible_causes.cause: Minimum-flow recycle is blocked or less open than intended, causing more pump discharge to go forward to HPU.
possible_causes.local_effect: Reduced recycle flow and increased forward flow.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Higher HPU feed flow and possible pump operation outside intended hydraulic balance.

possible_causes.cause: Pump discharge check valve fails open, leaks, or is stuck open while HPU/discharge header pressure is higher than pump/tank side pressure.
possible_causes.local_effect: Backflow through stopped or low-pressure pump path.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Reverse rotation or mechanical damage to 100P-01A/B; possible backflow toward 100T-01; HPU feed instability.

possible_causes.cause_source: Wrong line-up around pump discharge or recycle line
possible_causes.cause: Manual valves incorrectly aligned, allowing discharge header or recycle path to backflow toward tank/pump suction.
possible_causes.local_effect: Flow direction reverses in part of the transfer system.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Unintended tank filling, pump reverse flow, unstable HPU supply, or contamination/back-mixing into 100T-01.

possible_causes.cause_source: 100P-01A/B stopped while downstream pressure remains high
possible_causes.cause: Pump is stopped or tripped while downstream HPU/discharge pressure is higher than upstream tank-side pressure.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Backflow through pump if check valve does not hold; possible pump damage and tank level increase.

node_sections_covered: Tank vent line to activated carbon canister

possible_causes.cause: Nitrogen in-breathing control valve PCV-0101 fails open or nitrogen pressure is excessive.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank vapor pressure increases; possible vapor release through relief/vent paths and potential tank mechanical stress.

possible_causes.cause: Out-breathing valve PCV-0102 fails closed, vent line blocked, or activated carbon canister path restricted.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank pressure increases during filling, heating, or vapor generation; possible tank overpressure.

possible_causes.cause: Excess inflow or loss of outflow causes high/high-high level, reducing vapor space.
possible_causes.local_effect: Vapor space compression and increased venting demand.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank pressure rise, liquid carryover to vent system, possible release to atmosphere or bund.

possible_causes.cause: Downstream HPU line blocked or discharge valve closed while pump continues running.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Pump deadheading, overheating, line overpressure, seal damage, or loss of HPU feed.

possible_causes.cause: Liquid naphtha is trapped between closed valves and heated by ambient/fire/solar heat.
possible_causes.local_effect: Thermal expansion increases pressure in blocked-in liquid piping.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Potential piping overpressure, flange leakage, PSV lifting, or naphtha release.

possible_causes.cause: Fire or abnormal external heating increases liquid/vapor temperature and vapor generation.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank relief demand, vapor/naphtha release, escalation risk, and possible emergency venting.

possible_causes.cause: Nitrogen supply unavailable, PCV-0101 fails closed, or nitrogen blanketing line is blocked.
possible_causes.local_effect: Insufficient in-breathing to replace liquid withdrawal or vapor contraction.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank vapor pressure falls below normal; possible tank vacuum, roof/internal floating roof damage, or air ingress.

possible_causes.cause: Out-breathing valve PCV-0102 stuck open or vent path allows excessive vapor release.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Vacuum tendency, oxygen ingress risk, and increased flammable atmosphere potential in the vapor space.

possible_causes.cause: Rapid pump-out from 100T-01 without sufficient nitrogen make-up.
possible_causes.local_effect: Liquid volume decreases faster than vapor space is replenished.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank vacuum, internal roof damage, possible pump suction instability, and air ingress.

possible_causes.cause: Temperature decrease causes vapor condensation in the tank vapor space.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank vacuum condition and possible mechanical stress on the tank roof/shell.

possible_causes.cause_source: Inlet flow from Existing Process Unit / B-L
possible_causes.cause: Inlet flow continues or exceeds normal while outflow to HPU is reduced.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: High level or overfill of 100T-01; possible liquid release, vapor displacement, and high pressure in tank vapor space.

possible_causes.cause: Transfer pumps stopped, unavailable, or underperforming while inlet flow continues.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank inventory accumulates; high level, overfill, and possible feed interruption to HPU.

possible_causes.cause: Outlet valve closed or suction/discharge path blocked.
possible_causes.local_effect: Naphtha cannot be transferred from tank to pumps/HPU.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank level rises if inlet continues; potential overfill and vapor release.

possible_causes.cause: Reverse flow through failed pump discharge check valve or wrong line-up.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Unexpected tank level increase and possible overfill.

possible_causes.cause: Upstream feed stopped or reduced.
possible_causes.local_effect: Tank receives less naphtha than expected.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank level decreases; 100P-01A/B suction head decreases; HPU feed may be reduced or interrupted.

possible_causes.cause: Inlet shutdown valve or manual isolation valve closed when feed is required.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Tank level falls while transfer pumps continue; pump dry-running, cavitation, or HPU feed loss may occur.

possible_causes.cause: Pump-out rate exceeds inlet make-up rate.
possible_causes.local_effect: Inventory is drawn down faster than replenished.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Low tank level, low suction head, pump starvation/dry-running, and HPU feed instability.

possible_causes.cause_source: OWS/CSS drain valves or tank leakage
possible_causes.cause: Drain valve left open, drain path leakage, or tank/piping leak.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Low level, possible hydrocarbon release to drain/bund, pump suction loss, and HPU feed interruption.

possible_causes.cause: Incoming naphtha temperature is higher than normal or above intended operating temperature.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Higher vapor pressure, increased venting, tank pressure rise, increased vapor emissions, and possible pump NPSH reduction.

possible_causes.cause: High ambient temperature, solar heating, or external fire exposure.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Vapor generation and pressure rise in 100T-01; possible relief/vent demand and flammable vapor release.

possible_causes.cause: Pump operates at very low forward flow, deadheads, or recirculates excessively.
possible_causes.local_effect: Pump energy is converted into heat in the liquid.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Higher discharge/recycle temperature, pump damage, vapor formation, cavitation risk, and possible high pressure in trapped sections.

possible_causes.cause: Naphtha trapped between closed valves and heated.
possible_causes.local_effect: Thermal expansion and temperature increase in trapped liquid.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Local high pressure, leakage, or relief demand.

possible_causes.cause: Incoming naphtha temperature is lower than normal.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Reduced vapor pressure, possible tank vacuum tendency from vapor contraction, increased liquid viscosity, and possible reduction in pumpability.

possible_causes.cause: Low ambient temperature or abnormal cooling of stagnant naphtha in tank/piping.
possible_causes.local_effect: Temperature in tank or transfer piping decreases.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Possible low pressure/vacuum tendency in vapor space, sluggish flow, pump load increase, or operation outside design temperature if below -8 °C.

possible_causes.cause: Excessive venting or vaporization cools the remaining liquid/vapor space.
possible_causes.propagated_consequence: Pressure drop in vapor space and possible air ingress if tank pressure falls below atmospheric.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Detects inventory changes in 100T-01 caused by inlet/outlet flow imbalance.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Safeguard/monitoring layer; formal IPL credit requires independence and reliability verification.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Provides level signal associated with high-high and low-low level protection logic.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Safeguard/monitoring layer; may support IPL if independent of initiating cause and final element.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Provides operator visibility of tank level deviation.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Operator safeguard/monitoring only, not normally credited as standalone IPL without defined operator response time and alarm management.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Alerts operator to high tank level caused by excessive inlet flow, loss of pump-out, or reverse flow.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Alarm safeguard; formal IPL credit depends on alarm independence, priority, response time, and operator action.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Alerts operator to falling tank level caused by loss of inlet flow, excessive pump-out, drain leakage, or tank leakage.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Alarm safeguard; formal IPL credit depends on alarm management and operator response.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Detects high-high tank level and initiates high-level protection logic.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Candidate IPL input if independent, proof-tested, and credited in safety requirement specification.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: High-high level protection closes the inlet shutdown valve to stop additional filling of 100T-01.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Candidate IPL/SIS function for overfill prevention if independent and designed to required SIL or reliability target.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Detects low-low level in 100T-01 before pump dry-running condition becomes severe.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Candidate IPL input for pump dry-running protection if independent and proof-tested.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Trips 100P-01A/B and closes outlet shutdown valve to prevent pump dry-running when tank level is too low.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Candidate IPL/SIS function for pump protection if independent from the initiating cause.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Measures flow in the common naphtha discharge line to HPU.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Monitoring/safeguard instrument. Reverse-flow detection is not confirmed unless the transmitter is configured for bidirectional measurement.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Indicates abnormal HPU feed flow from pump discharge.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Operator monitoring safeguard, not a standalone IPL unless paired with alarm and defined operator response.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Processes or transmits flow signal associated with FT/FI-0101.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Signal processing element; IPL credit depends on complete loop design.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Provides local indication of tank vapor pressure affected by blanketing, venting, heating, cooling, or pump-out.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Monitoring safeguard; not normally IPL by itself.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Indicates abnormal discharge pressure from 100P-01A/B, including blocked discharge, deadheading, or backpressure conditions.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Monitoring safeguard.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Indicates naphtha temperature affecting vapor pressure, pressure deviation, pumpability, and thermal expansion.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Monitoring safeguard.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Alerts high temperature condition that can increase vapor pressure, venting demand, and pump cavitation risk.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Alarm safeguard; IPL credit depends on independence and operator response.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Alerts low temperature condition that can reduce vapor pressure and affect pumpability.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Alarm safeguard.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Manual emergency shutdown closes inlet/outlet shutdown valves and trips 100P-01A/B.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Emergency isolation safeguard; IPL credit depends on independence, human action assumptions, and shutdown system design.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Manual initiation of IS-28 from safe/outside bund locations.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Manual safeguard; formal IPL credit requires response time and accessibility validation.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Acts on inlet shutdown valve command from IS-09 or IS-28.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Final-element actuation component; can be part of IPL loop if independent and proof-tested.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Acts on outlet shutdown valve command from IS-10 or IS-28.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Final-element actuation component.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.type: inlet shutdown valve position feedback and alarm/status
related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Confirms whether inlet shutdown valve is open or closed.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Diagnostic safeguard; helps detect valve misposition but not usually a standalone IPL.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.type: outlet shutdown valve position feedback and alarm/status
related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Confirms whether outlet shutdown valve is open or closed.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Diagnostic safeguard.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Maintains nitrogen blanketing pressure during tank breathing.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Basic process control/safeguard. Not normally an IPL unless specifically designed independent of BPCS initiating causes.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Provides controlled tank out-breathing through activated carbon canister.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Basic process control/safeguard.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Provides secondary tank pressure/vacuum protection.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Candidate independent protection layer for tank overpressure/vacuum if sized, maintained, and independent.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Provides emergency venting for abnormal/fire scenarios.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Emergency relief safeguard; IPL credit depends on design basis.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.type: pressure safety valve / thermal relief valve
related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Relieves thermal expansion pressure from trapped liquid in transfer piping.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Candidate IPL for blocked-in liquid thermal expansion if properly sized and maintained.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Maintains continuous minimum recycle flow to protect 100P-01A/B from low-flow operation.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Pump protection safeguard; IPL status depends on whether it is independent and credited in design.

related_ipls_and_safeguards.related_cause_consequence_logic: Prevents reverse flow from HPU/discharge header through stopped transfer pumps.
related_ipls_and_safeguards.classification_note: Reverse-flow safeguard; not always credited as IPL unless reliability and independence are demonstrated.

reasoning_recheck.check_1_node_boundary: All deviations were evaluated across the full boundary from Existing Process Unit / B-L to 100T-01, 100P-01A/B, HPU, recycle, blanketing, vent, relief, and drain paths.
reasoning_recheck.check_2_cause_vs_consequence: Cause source and consequence target were kept separate. A cause at a valve, such as UV-0102-IN, can propagate to 100T-01 inventory, 100P-01A/B suction, and HPU feed.
reasoning_recheck.check_3_no_valve_as_endpoint: Valves and instruments are not used as from_id/to_id endpoints. They are used as cause_source, safeguards, or instruments acting on the node.
reasoning_recheck.check_4_safeguard_separation: The first field lists causes and consequences only. IPLs and safeguards are listed only after the cause-consequence pass.
reasoning_recheck.check_5_formal_ipl_warning: Items are listed as candidate IPLs/safeguards from the P&ID. Formal IPL credit requires independence, effectiveness, proof testing, response time, and reliability verification.
